title: Dorman Help 47016 Radiator Anti-Freeze Coolant Flush Kit w/ ½", ⅝" & ¾" Hose Tee
description_markdown: table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; } th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; } th { background-color: #f2f2f2; text-align: left; } Product Description Engineered for convenient flushing of the radiator, Dorman's Flush Kit provides you with everything necessary to complete the job. We recommend that you flush the radiator according to your vehicle manufacturer's maintenance schedule in order to prevent coolant leaks and damage to the gaskets. Include two clamps, multiple tees, a garden hose adapter, an elbow and a cap Easy to use Fresh coolant helps prevent freezing, overheating, and possible extensive damage to the car's cooling system Universal fit for a wide range of applications Product Specifications Adapter Colors: Yellow; Black Adapter Material: Plastic; Steel Adapters Included: Yes Case Included: No Color/Finish: Black; Yellow; Silver Coolant Type: Normal Flexible Nozzle: No Hoses Included: No Material: Plastic; Steel Nozzle Length (In): 4 in Nozzle Material: Plastic Package Contents: 1 Cap; 2 Hose Clamps; 1 Large T Fitting; 1 Small T Fitting; 1 Elbow; 1 Threaded Adapter Package Quantity: 1 Packaging Type: Card Universal Or Specific Fit: Universal Working Pressure: 15 PSI
